Grey broad-lapel coat/pale pointed shirt with grey neck button. Restrained slight smile, blue backdrop. Preserve facial hair extent/hat/glasses/outfit/crop/light; short broad fitted mascot neck.

Keep cigar placement/hair/clothes/crop/light; no invented moustache, short broad mascot neck.

Preserve actual restrained facial hair extent/uniform/buttons/crop/light; short broad fitted mascot neck.
